schedule: From future activation, fixed 2h slots for 1H and 25h slots for 24H; first issuance in 45m window; reserve full target window before observing outcomes
family: 4 groups x 2 horizons x (3 prediction + 6 regime prediction + 6 economic metrics) x 2 fixed looks x 2 directions = 480 one-sided comparisons
probability_comparator: Actual same-event paired frozen probability; production rule has no calibrated probability and gets direction comparison only
economic_rule: Same-event original published feature/control and verified-at-capture raw P2 V3.1 visible-depth books; nominal and double fee/slippage; cash and interval hold; no omitted missing intervals
missing_rule: Full due slots retained; forecast effects bounded adversarially for missing; economic inference requires all due slots complete, never zero-fill unknown cost
inference: Fixed calendar moving blocks, Bonferroni tails; approximate under adequate stationarity/mixing, not finite-sample guarantee; independent review required
new_factor_registration: Only existing frozen four-group perturbations reused; other 36-catalog research candidates need a new future protocol, never an ad-hoc family extension
retirement_rule: Reliable negative direction gain vs both frozen production and paired control, plus negative Brier gain vs paired; evidence/PIT faults isolate data and do not demonstrate negative predictive value
promotion_rule: Reliable positive joint direction/Brier gain, no material regime harm and reliable nominal/stress economic excess over paired/cash/interval hold; recommend manual review only
